matter: The front board of the library's binding, in blue cloth, with the spine at the right; worn and patched; not part of the edition.
The ownership stamp «COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY THE LIBRARIES IN THE CITY OF NEW YORK», round, with a crown, in the middle of the leaf; not part of the edition.
The stamp «Provided by the Library of Congress Public Law 480 Program» at the head of the leaf: the programme through which the copy was acquired; not part of the edition.
The number «70-961379» written in pencil at the head of the leaf, a number of the library's records; not part of the edition.

The call mark «ButlStax G 93 .K48» written in pencil at the top: Butler Library stacks, the call number of the copy; not part of the edition. The calligraphy of the title page shows through from the recto.
A small curved dark mark, perhaps a fibre, in the lower left margin of the page.
A faint grey curl beside the zero sign of the minutes of the latitude of entry 114 (L17).
A faint grey curl, perhaps a fibre, beside the minutes of the latitude of entry 145 (L17), and a smaller one beside the minutes of the latitude of entry 144 (L16).
A fine dark hairline, one or two pixels wide, crosses the ج of «الجبل» in entry 174 (L10) and runs down to the left below the line; a fibre or a scratch, not a stroke of the type.
A fine dark vertical hairline, 2 px wide, crosses the teeth of the س of «قٮرس» (L18) and runs down below the line; a fibre or a scratch, not a stroke of the type.
A faint grey curl, perhaps a fibre, below the degrees of the longitude of entry 298 (L12).
A thin dark slanting hairline below the bracket of the number of Suhrāb of entry 336 (L01), a scratch or a fibre.

A faint wavy grey hairline lies below the number of Suhrāb of entry 415 (L03), a fibre on the paper.

Faint wavy grey hairlines, fibres on the paper: L07, between the columns of the latitude; L08, below «الجبل».
Faint wavy grey hairlines, fibres on the paper: L02, to the right of the heading; L08, to the left of the name.
Faint grey hairlines, fibres on the paper: L07, below the degrees of the latitude; L12, between the degrees of the latitude and the minutes of the longitude.

A faint grey hairline, a fibre on the paper, lies below the name in L08.

Faint grey hairlines, fibres on the paper: L10, a hairline curled into two small loops to the left of the minutes of the last longitude; L12, a short wavy hairline between the first and the last boundary; L15, a curved hairline above the ض of «وعرضه».
Faint grey hairlines, fibres on the paper: L13, a curved hairline between the first and the last boundary; L16, a curled hairline below the degrees of the first latitude.

Faint grey hairlines, fibres on the paper: L06, a curl at the left of the degrees of the last longitude; L11, a small ring above the space between the last longitude and the last latitude; L13, a hairline between the first and the last boundary; L16, a curl beside the degrees of the first latitude.
